pieces.Text: You have focused on honing your innate magical talents.

Choose one spell-like ability you have that is a 0- or 1st-level spell. Once this choice is made, it cannot be changed. You can use a chosen 0-level spell two additional times per day or the chosen 1st-level spell one additional time per day. Prerequisites: At least one spell-like ability that is a level-0 or 1st-level spell, character level 4th.
